verdict.rationale: Omnara's docs state you can configure which actions require approval and agents pause to ask for input, plus role-based access controls for who can operate/configure agents — this supports human-oversight/autonomy gating but is not documented as explicit 'tiers' or autonomy levels. missing for 10: named autonomy-level presets (e.g., low/medium/high), documentation showing granular per-action approval configuration UI, and independent/hands-on confirmation of this specific control mechanism.
